comment: Metric-view base for the onboarding funnel (mv_onboarding_funnel, D13): a record_type union of Case rows (one per onboarding case - is_primary_row), Product Request rows (one per case x product requested), Document rows (one per KYC document requested) and Feedback rows (one per post-onboarding survey). Case descriptors (booking country, segment, request month / fiscal year, status, current stage, owner, blocker, match timing, KYC-migration period, over-SLA and stuck-in-KYC-Docs flags) repeat on every row for slicing; case measures are populated only on Case rows, document / feedback / product fields only on their own rows, so counts never double. Examples: Cases Opened = COUNT_IF(is_primary_row); Conversion to Live % = COUNT_IF(is_live) / COUNT_IF(is_primary_row AND NOT is_open); Matched to Existing Group % = COUNT_IF(matched_existing_group) / COUNT_IF(is_primary_row); documents outstanding = COUNT_IF(is_document_outstanding); average satisfaction = AVG(satisfaction_score). Grain: one row per record_type x record (case, case x product, document or survey response).
